title: Materialized View Pattern — Companion Resources
title_es: Patrón de Vista Materializada — Recursos complementarios
description: Ready-to-adapt materialized view implementations: Django + Celery refresh tasks, a Spring @Scheduled refresh service, and PostgreSQL native materialized views with a trigger-based incremental refresh.
description_es: Implementaciones de vistas materializadas listas para adaptar: tareas de refresco con Django + Celery, un servicio de refresco con Spring @Scheduled y vistas materializadas nativas de PostgreSQL con refresco incremental por trigger.
